simulation_effects: Rumors retain origin, path, confidence and scope; hop limits and decay rates are engine-tunable safeguards rather than canonical constants.
Knowledge claims transition among UNKNOWN, CONTESTED, VERIFIED_TRUE and VERIFIED_FALSE only through direct or independently verified evidence.
Relationships and reputations replay from immutable events, allowing a local consequence to be audited after a death, quest or rebirth.
Rebirth echoes enter as subjective claims and cannot prove identity, historical fact or legal inheritance by themselves.
story_generators: Uma cidade transforma um rumor sobre o renascido em reputação hostil, embora a única testemunha direta o defenda.
Dois fragmentos independentes revelam que uma lembrança de eco era verdadeira, mas a verdade fere uma aliança local.
Uma relação de confiança sobrevive como sensação depois da morte, enquanto a pessoa reencontrada não reconhece o novo corpo.

compatibility.v1_0: Preserved as historical source; V1.1 removes prototype tuning values from canon while retaining provenance and evidence rules.
compatibility.memory_contract: The Stage16 contract is a compatible derived source only; its code and storage design are not UE5 requirements.
compatibility.r2: No rumor, private memory or runtime evidence can rewrite a sealed R2 fact.
